memorial_spots.name: Sanjivan samadhi of Dnyaneshwar
memorial_spots.where_within_site: Gabhara (inner sanctum) of the temple complex beside the Siddheshwar temple, Alandi
memorial_spots.story: Where tradition says he entered living samadhi in 1296 CE (Shaka 1218), on Kartik Vadya Trayodashi; Vishwakosh says nine days of kirtan followed.
memorial_spots.custodian: Alandi Devasthan (per newspapers; official site not opened)
memorial_spots.coordinate_source: Yatradham temple page for the Alandi samadhi temple: the page prints no coordinates as text, but its embedded Google Maps link, labelled as the samadhi temple, encodes 18.6769834 N 73.8966973 E (DNYG-P-S38)
memorial_spots.revision_note: Coordinates added from the Yatradham map embed (Q4). It is a single weak source; it differs from the Alandi village centre (18.676944, 73.896944) by about 25 m only.

memorial_spots.name: Siddheshwar temple

memorial_spots.coordinate_source: Yatradham temple page for the Alandi samadhi temple: the page prints no coordinates as text, but its embedded Google Maps link, labelled as the samadhi temple, encodes 18.6769834 N 73.8966973 E (DNYG-P-S38). Used for the whole complex: the Siddheshwar temple is adjacent to the samadhi and no separate coordinates were found.
memorial_spots.coordinate_precision: temple (whole complex; spot itself not located)
memorial_spots.revision_note: Coordinates are those of the samadhi temple complex, not of this building.

memorial_spots.coordinate_source: Yatradham temple page for the Alandi samadhi temple: the page prints no coordinates as text, but its embedded Google Maps link, labelled as the samadhi temple, encodes 18.6769834 N 73.8966973 E (DNYG-P-S38). Used for the whole complex: the ajan tree's position is not given by any source.
memorial_spots.coordinate_precision: temple (whole complex; spot itself not located)

memorial_spots.name: The wall (bhint) of the Changdev episode
memorial_spots.where_within_site: Inside the Alandi complex (exact spot not stated by sources opened)
memorial_spots.story: Tradition: the siblings sat on a wall which moved forward to greet Changdev, who arrived on a tiger; Changdev then yielded (Vishwakosh S043; en Wikipedia S01 repeats it as legend). Not to be confused with the later fortifying wall of 1750 in the same complex (see building_phases).
memorial_spots.coordinate_source: Yatradham temple page for the Alandi samadhi temple: the page prints no coordinates as text, but its embedded Google Maps link, labelled as the samadhi temple, encodes 18.6769834 N 73.8966973 E (DNYG-P-S38). Used for the whole complex: the wall's position is not given by any source.
memorial_spots.coordinate_precision: temple (whole complex; spot itself not located)
memorial_spots.revision_note: Coordinates are those of the samadhi temple complex, not of the wall. source_id corrected from the non-existent DNYP-S043 to S043 (Vishwakosh).

institutions.name: Alandi Devasthan (Shri Dnyaneshwar Maharaj Sansthan, Alandi)
institutions.website_note: Official site not located: search returned only third-party pages and a direct fetch of the presumed domain was blocked by the tool allowlist, so no URL is recorded Searched again on 25 Nov 2026 in Marathi and English (three queries); results were only newspapers, Wikipedia mirrors and travel directories. No official URL recorded.
institutions.publishes: Per newspapers: announces the annual palkhi programme (the palkhi sohala head announced the 2026 schedule at the Devasthan, S13); organises Alandi festival programmes (Lokmat 2024 daily schedule S20); Harinam saptah on the birth-anniversary night (S22). The site itself was not read.
institutions.notes: Described as a trust; a hereditary Chopdar family role in the palkhi and the Devasthan Trust are named together in S23. Trustee names omitted deliberately.
institutions.revision_note: Re-searched for the official site; still not found. No new institution rows for Nevasa or Apegaon: no source opened names a trust (see coverage).
